stableDifference.detail: The older stable tree predates main commit 42d2b9dd, which added identity stabilization to restore review-stream responsiveness. The pinned main implementation and all four additional tests are retained.

invariants: navigation stops are derived only from measured row stable keys
context rows expose one canonical new-side stop addressable by either side's number
split rows enumerate old then new while stack rows follow measured vertical order
expanded source lines retain their exact gap identity
stepping uses a cached cursor index and clamps at review-stream edges
reload recovery remains inside the cursor's prior hunk or file
viewport clamping uses monotonic binary search and requires the current row to be fully visible
equivalent remeasurement preserves list and index storage identity

nativeAdaptation.identity: Arc-backed cursor and index storage replaces JavaScript array identity and WeakMap indexes
nativeAdaptation.geometry: ViewportSectionGeometry is Workdeck's measured Ratatui row-bounds projection
